title: RENO Source Page Frontmatter
description: Flat YAML frontmatter for bounded source pages stored under wiki/source/. Source hubs use the base summary frontmatter (frontmatter.schema.json with type=summary) and are not validated by this schema. Fields are taken from AGENTS.md; reasoning fields, Phase 3 fields, and the legacy 'domain' tag are intentionally excluded.

id.description: Stable kebab-case page id; equals the markdown filename without the .md suffix.

type.description: Bounded source pages always have type=source. Source hubs use type=summary and are not validated by this schema.

phase.description: Phase 1 cannot produce a source page; that is why phase-1-parsed is excluded here.

parent.description: id of the source hub when one exists; null only for stand-alone single-section sources.

prev.description: id of the previous bounded source page in chunk-chain order, or null for the first page.

next.description: id of the next bounded source page in chunk-chain order, or null for the last known page.

raw_id.description: Must equal manifest.raw_id for the same source-id.

processed_ids.description: Every value must equal manifest.processed_id. A list is used so future per-section processed runs can be referenced without schema churn.

chunk_ids.description: Contiguous chunk_ids, in chain order, that this bounded page extracts from. Every entry must exist as a real chunk JSON under processed/<source-id>/chunks/.

title.description: Human-readable title for this bounded slice. Optional.

section_range.description: When present, should match manifest.section_range for the underlying chunks.
